title: One sheet goes around the table.
body: You write a line, fold the paper over it so only the last few words show, and pass it on. Some call it Consequences, some call it Exquisite Corpse.

title: Now the paper is on everyone’s phone.
body: You see only the start of the sentence the last player left. Finish it and tap “fold the page”: the paper folds over your words. Then start the next sentence for whoever comes after you.

title: Then you unfold it together.
body: After the last line, everyone gets the same story on one sheet of paper, signed by everyone who wrote it. Someone reads it out loud.

finalStory.rest: Natalie found an old letter under the door.

finalStory.join: Inside, in tiny handwriting, it said
finalStory.rest: the cat had been paying the rent for years.
until the landlord sent the cat a thank-you card.
the whole building wanted cat lessons.
